A guard whose comment claims more than its code delivers has now appeared five times here; this is what that looks like when it is a single character.

quotation stripping is dropped, so a commit that FIXES a stale trailer cannot describe the number it is fixing. That is the failure this repo has made three times in other guards: the rule gets worded obliquely enough to dodge its own checker, which damages the rule to protect the checker. A check that forbids explaining the defect it catches will be worked around, and a worked-around rule protects nothing.

the check is written, tested and never called -- the shape Stage 3 closed with, where src/collect_agent_log.py was fully tested and had never run. A check absent from preflight()'s list is invisible: the tool prints the checks it ran, so nothing says the missing one is missing, and CI goes green because it always did.
